definition: Classifier chains is a machine learning method for problem transformation in multi-label classification.
details: It combines the computational efficiency of the binary relevance method while still being able to take the label dependencies into account for classification.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. And that is Classifier chains — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
